public_inputs.calculation_spec: At each interval compute heat deficit=max(0,(setpoint-return_temp-deadband)*heat_deficit_kw_per_deg_c). Select the smallest available stage meeting the deficit, subject to max_stage_change_per_interval from the previous command. Corrected return temperature = measured return + stage_kw/heat_deficit_kw_per_deg_c. Energy = sum(stage_kw*interval_hours).
